newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate closes softer.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate closes softer.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate ended softer on Wednesday as abundant liquidity pushed local banks to liquidate excess funds, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 5.120 percent against Tuesday's 5.162 close, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 5.15-5.20.

But dealers expected the central bank to mop up liquidity through NCD issues if the overnight rate falls to around 5.00 percent. In the bond market, the seven-year 86/3 bond yield was traded at 5.94 percent in early session. No trade was reported in the afternoon.
